// why this exists: Type-checks the reply CARRIER, which is the thing four hand-shaped attempts kept
getting wrong while passing at runtime (see reply-item.ts):
Scoped to reply-item.ts on purpose. The rest of the harness is throwaway glue whose
generic-variance noise would bury the one signal this check exists to give.
The explicit `paths` are not decoration. pnpm installs per package, so there is no
root node_modules to resolve `@flow-state-dev/core` from; without them tsc silently
types the import as `any`, `MessageItem` becomes `any`, and the check reports clean
while catching nothing. That false green happened here once already — verify the
check can FIRE (delete a required field, expect an error) before trusting it green.
Still outside the workspace: no package.json here, so turbo's typecheck and knip
never see it and a spec PR's CI stays green (spec-poc/README.md).
